how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_103.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.pride.descrip: Turn the strength of your opponents into your own and turn the tides of battle. Copy abilities when you are struck by them, provided you meet the necessary conditions.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ranged_barrie: Place down differently sized barriers which block enemies in or out. Strong attacks can still destroy them.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reaper.descri: Do recon by becoming smaller and more agile while seeing all enemies nearby. Spawn clones, or consume the essence of your enemies to obliterate them in a single strike.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.recovery.desc: Greatly recover a living being's health as well as food points.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reflector.des: Turn back the tides of battle by reflecting all of the received damage. Unleash a devastating projectile attack or counter an attack directly.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reincarnation: Sacrifice a portion of the caster's power to reincarnate.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reinforced_ba: Coat the caster with reinforced Barriers with the strength based on Health.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reinforcement: Greatly enhance the caster's gears durability.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.researcher.de: Study ancient magic tomes, reverse engineer them, and create wonders beyond imagination.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.reverser.desc: Flip the rules. Change alignments, invert buffs and debuffs while shifting strengths and weaknesses to your benefit.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.roaring_lion_: Focus your aura into a fearsome blow with the regalness of a lion.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.royal_beast.d: Unleash a primal fury and gain a massive physical boost to crush your enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sacred_haki.d: Strike fear into the hearts of evil and give strength to your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sage.descript: Increase the speed at which you learn and master skills, magic and arts.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.scale_armor.d: Like the lizardmen, move through water and mud with no penalties while receiving a slight defense buff.
Highlight hostile mobs around the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.seeker.descri: Accelerate thought processing to extreme levels, mastery over magics and manipulate the fundamental laws governing the world to optimize actions and outcomes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.seer.descript: See everything. Foresee your opponent’s moves. Dodge or mitigate their attacks and predict their movement to score critical strikes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.self_regenera: Speed up your body’s natural regeneration to increase your survivability.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sense_heat_so: Highlights entities that generate heat nearby.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sense_soundwa: Empower your ears to precisely locate any nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.severer.descr: Slice through reality and manifest spatial blades which cut through armor and unleash devastating blade storms.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_bind.d: If the target is standing in shadows, bind them and deal spiritual damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_motion: Melt into the shadows and move unseen by all but the most keen observers.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shadow_strike: Become one with the shadows and deal massive spiritual damage and become immune to lesser presence detection.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.shrink.descri: Reduce your size to enhance your evasion but increase your vulnerability
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sleep_mist.de: Release a wide area of sleeping mist to paralyze targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sloth.descrip: Grind the world to a halt. Put your enemies into a deadly sleep, drain their power and rest to regain any lost vitality. May lethargy take over.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.snake_eye.des: Apply various debuff on targets on sight.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sniper.descri: Deal damage from afar while using different bullets to get past resistances and ensure a quick kill.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_beam.de: Fire a light beam that deals massive damage to undead entities and burns blocks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_flare.d: Shoot a shockwave of light energy to give nausea, blindness and slowness to all targets in a wide AOE.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_rain.de: Shoot many light projectiles that deal massive damage to undead creatures.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.solar_wave.de: Shoot a wave of light energy that blinds and slows hit enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sound_dominat: Boosts Sound abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.sound_manipul: Boosts Sound abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.space.descrip: Form invisible platforms to create footholds midair.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.space_transfo: Channel the powers of space to weaken and damage all nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_attac: Ignore weaker spatial attacks or reduce the damage from stronger dimensional strikes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_domin: Boosts Space abilities by a large amount and deals massive damage by splitting a target with dimensional attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_manip: Boosts Space abilities by a decent amount and manipulate space to empower your ranged attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_motio: Tear space asunder granting yourself and your allies safe passage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spatial_stora: Rift space to create a small pocket dimension to store items.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spearhead.des: Empower and command your allies, and then collect their abilities once they pass on.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.spiritual_att: Ignore weaker spiritual attacks or resist stronger ones.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.starved.descr: Consume all in your path or have your rampaging subordinates do it. Corrode your enemies, devour their strength, and adding their abilities to your own.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.steel_strengt: Strengthen your muscles and gain an increase in damage, toggleable when mastered.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.strength.desc: Use magicule to strengthen your muscles.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.strength_aspe: Greatly enhance the caster's strength power.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.strengthen_bo: Strengthen your body to better protect yourself against attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_basili: Summon a Basilisk to temporarily fight for you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_daemon: Summon a Daemon from hell to fight for you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_greate: Summon your contracted greater elemental spirit to have it purge the world of heretics for you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_hound_: Summon a Hound Dog to temporarily fight for you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_medium: Summon your contracted elemental spirit to temporarily fight for you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.summon_otherw: Summon a human from a different world.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.suppressor.de: Restrict teleportation, confuse enemies by swapping places, and use your blink as well as the spatial gate to cross large distances.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.survivor.desc: Endure and outheal anything, resist physical and natural damage and withstand overwhelming odds.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.swipe.descrip: Slashing through space in a straight line, displacing entities or teleporting the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.telepathy.des: Give orders to tames when looking at them through commands.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.teleport.desc: Quickly blink forward in space to a location within view.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thermal_fluct: Ignore weaker thermal damage regardless of its type or resist stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thought_accel: Increase the speed at which you think to cast magic more quickly as well as to increase your reaction speed.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thought_commu: Send commands to nearby allies and become able to instruct them to attack players.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thrower.descr: Use your skill and your precision to throw anything and deal massive damage. You can even shove air or push back your foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder.descr: Strike powerful thunder where the caster looks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_breat: Release thunder from your mouth to damage foes in front of you.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_lance: Strike powerful thunder lances of magic.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.thunder_orb.d: Call forth a sphere of thunder that strikes any enemy get by.
Call forth a wide area of thunder clouds that strike all enemies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.titanificatio: Grow into a towering titan to massively increase your strength, defense, and reach while gaining immunity to magic from weaker foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.tornado_blade: Fire a concentrated sphere of wind toward targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.traveler.desc: Move freely through space, teleport large distances or create spatial gates. Manipulate stardust to immense damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.true_darkness: Inflict Blindness on all entities and deal massive spiritual damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.tuner.descrip: Change your fate survive fatal blows, regenerate instantly and manipulate probability.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultra_instinc: Enhance your sense to dodge physical impact.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultrasonic_wa: Shoot out a screech of sound which damages physical bodies or use echolocation to highlight nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.ultraspeed_re: Boost your bodies healing to nearly impossible levels
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.universal_per: Combine all magic, sound and heat sense to detect entities around.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.unpredictabil: In the hands of a True Hero, unpredictability reigns supreme. The Hero sees all, becoming able to ignore dodge and even read the movements of their opponent to disable their critical attacks or their dodge avoidance.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.unyielding.de: Draw power from loyal allies. Fortify subordinates and seamlessly switch to a backup body to stay in the fight.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.usurper.descr: Seize your enemies' power or their summons. Steal their abilities and take control of their skills, draining their strength for your own.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.villain.descr: Embody malice and fight on the side of evil. Gain increased power from killing your foes, manipulate your enemies into joining your side and empower your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.violent_break: Channel your aura, recklessly enhancing your strength and cleansing you of any negative effects.
Fire powerful blasts of concentrated sound waves by producing loud vocal sounds atomizing weaker targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.warp_portal.d: Tear space asunder connecting two points in space.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water.descrip: Call forth or manipulate small amounts of water.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_aspectu: Call forth small amounts of water.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_attack_: Ignore weaker water-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_blade.d: Shoot out a blade of water which flies in a straight line.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_breathi: Remove the requirement of air underwater.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_current: Manipulate water around you to propel yourself in any direction.
Fires a concentrated blade to cut your enemies with the power of water.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_cutter_: Fire concentrated blades of water toward targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_dominat: Boosts Water abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_jail.de: Surround targets with flows of water.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_manipul: Boosts Water abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.water_transfo: Channel the powers of water to damage and poison all nearby foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.weather_domin: Use magicule to manipulate the weather with a higher efficiency.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.weather_manip: Use magicule to manipulate the weather.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind.descript: Call forth a small gust of wind which can push targets away or the player up.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_attack_r: Ignore weaker wind damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_blade.de: Fires a concentrated blade of wind which has heavy knockback.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_cutter.d: Fire concentrated blades of wind toward targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_dominati: Boosts Wind abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_gust.des: Release strong currents of winds to create gusts or wind charges toward targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_manipula: Boosts Wind abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_protecti: Call forth flows of wind to coat the caster with speed and protection.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wind_transfor: Channel the powers of wind to paralyze and damage all nearby entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.wrath.descrip: Unleash pure rage and use it to get infinitely stronger the longer your anger persists. Beware of the devastating drawback.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.telepathy.subordina: All reached subordinates' behaviour have been set to to Passive.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.world_restriction.e: World Restriction Area [%s] has banned all modes of %s.
